longTitle.officialTitle: To authorize appropriations for the Department of State, the United States Information Agency, and related agencies, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

subsection.heading: Authorization of Appropriations.—
subsection.content: There are authorized to be appropriated $219,745,000 for the fiscal year 1994 and $234,745,000 for the fiscal year 1995 to carry out the Peace Corps Act.

subsection.heading: Availability of Funds.—
subsection.content: Funds made available to the Peace Corps pursuant to the authorization under subsection (a) shall be available for the fiscal year for which appropriated and the subsequent year.
